articles.text: TÓNGXUÉ A: Nǐ zuìjìn kàn bào le meiyou?
CLASSMATE A: Have you been reading the papers lately?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Shénme bào?
CLASSMATE B: What papers?
TÓNGXUÉ A: Dàlù bàozhǐ. Yǒu yíjiàn shìqing hěn yǒu yìsi, bù zhīdào nǐ zhùyì le meiyou?
CLASSMATE A: The mainland newspapers. I wonder if you've noticed something very interesting.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Shénme shì?
CLASSMATE B: What?
TÓNGXUÉ A: Zìyóu shìchǎng.
CLASSMATE A: Free markets.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Ng, wǒ yě kàndào le. Wǒ xiǎng zhèi shi yíge bāngzhu nóngmín zhuàn qiánde hǎo bànfǎ.
CLASSMATE B: Mm, I've seen that too. I think it's a good way to help peasants make money.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Lìngwài yìdiǎn, nóngmínde shōurù duō le, duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yě yǒu hǎochu.
CLASSMATE A: And another point is that it will be good for agricultural production if the peasants' income goes up.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Duì, wǒ xiǎng wèile ràng xiāngxiàde shēngchǎn hé shēnghuó qíngkuàng hǎo yìdiǎn, zhèiyàngde shìchǎng yīnggāi bànxiaqu.
CLASSMATE B: Right. I think they ought to continue running these markets in order to make production and living conditions in the country better.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Érqiě, chénglǐ rénde shēnghuó yě huì hǎo yìdiǎnr, tāmen kěyi zài zìyóu shìchǎng mǎidào xīnxiānde cài, zhēnshi bú cuò.
CLASSMATE A: What's more, life will be better for people in the cities. They can buy fresh foods at the free markets. It's really pretty good.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Yǐhòu zìyóu shìchǎng yuè bàn yuè hǎo, xiāngxiàde xiǎo gōngshāngyè yě huì fādáqilai, dàlùde jīngjì qíngkuàng huì yǒu hěn dàde gǎibiàn.

CLASSMATE B: In the future, free markets will get better and better, small industry and commerce in the countryside will begin to prosper, and there will be big changes in the mainland's economic situation.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Wǒ jìde nǐ lǎojiā zài Jiāngxī.
CLASSMATE A: I remember your family is from Jiāngxī.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Shì. Tīng wǒ fùqin shuō, tāmen jǐdài rén dōu zhù zài Jiāngxī xiāngxià.
CLASSMATE B: Yes. My father tells me that they lived in the Jiāngxī countryside for several generations.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Xiànzài lǎojiā hái yǒu rén ba?
CLASSMATE A: You still have family there, don't you?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Yǒu, wǒ tīngshuō nàrde qíngkuàng xiànzài bú cuò le.
CLASSMATE B: Yes. I understand that the situation there is pretty good now.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Nà hǎo, yǒu jīhui xiǎng huíqu kànkan ba?
CLASSMATE A: That's good — if you have the chance do you want to go back to visit?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Yídìng!
CLASSMATE B: Sure!
